verdict.rationale: Skyfire is an agentic-commerce identity and payments layer, so asking about cart or order-draft calls is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence only documents token creation (kya, pay, kya-pay), token charging and introspection, MCP tools for seller discovery and token minting, and card authorizations capped at an approved merchant and amount. Nothing describes an API or protocol call to create or update a cart, line items or an order draft.
